Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Who we are
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The opportunity
 The role is offered within the Digital Services unit, and more specifically in the Digital Payment & Security Business entity, which designs, develops, and hosts payment and multi-channel authentication applications for large French and international accounts.
 The "Trusted Authentication" project aims to develop strong authentication solutions to ensure the security of digital transactions. In a world where data security is paramount, this project is part of an approach focused on innovation and user protection.
 In this context we propose a lead developer position embedded in a brand-new support team to participate from design to delivery of various patch fixes, supported by your squad lead as well as a whole project team that is yet to be built.
 Day-to-day responsibilities
 1. Manage and maintain Linux/RedHat systems in Worldline's production environment, ensuring high availability and performance in accordance with SLAs
 2. Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve system-related issues while maintaining service level agreements (SLAs) and platform availability targets
 3. Perform regular system updates and patch management ensuring systems are current with latest security updates
 4. Participate in disaster recovery planning and testing, ensuring business continuity and system resilience
 5. Configure and optimize system automation tools and scripts to improve operational efficiency
 6. Collaborate with security teams to maintain compliance with PCI DSS and other relevant security standards in the Linux environment In a Cloud context, the System Engineer role is adapted and called now SysOPS. This role is present in the entire lifecycle of any service hosted in the cloud. He is mainly responsible for deploying, managing and operating systems on the Cloud platforms.
 Who are we looking for
 1.Technical expert with proven experience in systems administration, preferably in a financial services or payment processing environment
 2. Strong knowledge of redhat, centos systems and cloud principles and best practices.
 3. Experience with business continuity planning and disaster recovery procedures
 4. Excellent problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to system monitoring and optimization
 5. Experience in system administration or Linux systems or a similar role;
 Perks & Benefits 
 In addition to joining a global leader in payments, you can also expect an excellent range of benefits. These include a rewarding salary, leave days, an attractive pension scheme, global learning days and many more. We also have location specific benefits, varying from private medical insurance, to extended parental leave and a flexible benefits scheme, allowing you to purchase discounted products and services.
 If you join us, you will enjoy:
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Free private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform

 Our success comes from strong skills, new insights, diverse points of view and the energy of all employees at Worldline. Not only do they represent the Heart and Face of our company, they are also key players in our success. We make leading our talents a major asset in the success of our business.
